decisions.quote: Thus, according to the criteria outlined by SCORE, the replication of the effect of stereotype threat on the gender gap on political knowledge was unsuccessful even after the second stage of data collection.
decisions.reason: The paper's title and preregistered SCORE criteria focus on the focal claim that stereotype activation contributes to the gender gap in political knowledge, and the authors explicitly state an overall verdict that the replication was unsuccessful (a non-replication), which outweighs ancillary agreement on the baseline gender main effect.
